title: Favorite Memory
description: Send your partner a text describing your favorite physical memory of them.

title: Whispered Desire
description: Send a voice message whispering one thing you want to do to them tonight.

title: Subtle Tease
description: Text your partner a subtle photo of what you are wearing right now.

title: Turn-On Trio
description: Send a text listing three specific things your partner does that instantly turn you on.

title: Secret Keyword
description: Text your partner a secret keyword. Whenever either of you says it tonight, the other must touch them.

title: Countdown Timer
description: Send a text setting a countdown timer for when you get to touch each other tonight.

title: Fantasy Question
description: Text your partner a 'Yes/No' question about a fantasy you’ve never tried together.

title: Daily Mandate
description: Send a text giving your partner one rule they must follow for the rest of the day.

title: Style Choice
description: Text your partner asking them to choose your underwear/attire for tonight.

title: First Touch Preview
description: Send a teaser text describing exactly where your hands will go the moment you are alone.

title: Rear Embrace
description: Give your partner a long, silent hug from behind for at least 30 seconds.

title: Spine Trace
description: Walk up to your partner, trace your finger down their spine, and walk away without saying a word.

title: Neck Kisses
description: Kiss your partner’s neck three times, then immediately return to what you were doing.

title: Static Hold
description: Hold hands with your partner for 2 minutes while doing whatever routine task you are doing.

title: Ear Whispers
description: Whisper a secret desire directly into your partner’s ear while standing close behind them.

title: Hair & Cheeks
description: Run your fingers through your partner’s hair while giving them a slow, soft kiss on the cheek.

title: Thigh Contact
description: Touch your partner’s inner thigh under the table/desk for 10 seconds.

title: Extended Kiss
description: Pull your partner in for a deep kiss that lasts at least 15 seconds—no hands below the waist yet.

title: Lip Trace
description: Trace your partner’s lips with your thumb while looking directly into their eyes.

title: Lower Back Touch
description: Rest your hand on your partner’s lower back while walking or standing together.

title: Gentle Bite
description: Give your partner a gentle bite on the lower lip during a kiss.

title: Heartbeat Connection
description: Place your partner's hand over your heart so they can feel your pulse.

title: Eye Lock
description: Maintain uninterrupted eye contact with your partner for 60 seconds without speaking.

title: Lip Bite Tease
description: Look at your partner from across the room and slowly bite your bottom lip until they notice.

title: Proximity Test
description: Stand face-to-face, less than an inch apart, without touching for 30 seconds.

title: Silent Wink
description: Give your partner 'the look' and wink at them without explaining why.

title: Teasing Warning
description: Whisper 'You have no idea what's coming later' next to their ear.

title: Slow Glance
description: Catch your partner’s eye and slowly run your tongue over your top teeth.

title: Full Scan
description: Look your partner up and down slowly, ending with a smile.

title: Continuous Contact
description: Sit next to your partner and let your shoulders and legs touch continuously for 5 minutes.

title: No-Touch Protocol
description: Establish a temporary rule: No touching allowed for the next 30 minutes, no matter what.

title: Forbidden Garment
description: Tell your partner one specific piece of clothing they are not allowed to wear later.

title: One-Handed Service
description: Pour your partner a drink or bring them a snack using only your left hand while keeping your right on their hip.

title: Atmosphere Shift
description: Dim the lights in the main room and put on a smooth background song.

title: Sensory Trace
description: Tell your partner to close their eyes while you brush a feather, soft cloth, or fingertips across their wrist.

title: Shoulder Rub
description: Give your partner a 1-minute shoulders and neck rub with zero expectations of going further yet.

title: Two Truths & A Lie
description: Tell your partner two truth statements and one lie about what you want to do tonight—they have to guess the lie.

title: Whisper Mode
description: Set a timer for 10 minutes. Until it rings, you can only communicate using whispers.

title: Secret Note
description: Write a short, naughty note on a piece of paper and slip it into your partner’s pocket or hands.

title: Anticipation Check
description: Ask your partner to rate their current anticipation level from 1 to 10 and tell you how to raise it by two points.

title: Hand Feeding
description: Feed your partner a bite of food or a piece of fruit by hand.

title: Body Praises
description: Gently whisper three compliments about your partner's body while holding their hands.

title: Partial Access
description: Unbutton or unzip one item of your partner's clothing, then tell them they have to wait for the rest.

title: Blind Tracing
description: Trace an invisible letter or word on your partner's palm or back and make them guess what it is.

title: Kitchen Slow Dance
description: Put your partner's hand on your hip and slow dance for one full song in the kitchen or living room.

title: Lipstick Mark
description: Apply lip balm or lipstick and press a kiss onto your partner's neck or collarbone.

title: Wrist Kiss
description: Give your partner a slow, deliberate kiss on the inside of their wrist.

title: Lap Rest
description: Sit on your partner's lap for 1 minute while talking about your day.

title: Warm Breath
description: Gently blow on the back of your partner's neck while standing behind them.

title: Direct Intention
description: Hold your partner by the waist, look them in the eyes, and say: 'I've been thinking about you all day.'
